title: Conscious and unconscious responses
log: 2026-11-01T14:46:42Z write: the API refused it in the chapter request, so it is written on its own next

draft.title: Conscious and unconscious responses
card: a response where the person is aware of the stimulus and chooses how to act. The brain processes the message before the body responds.
a response that happens without awareness or choice. The body acts before the brain is aware of the stimulus.
A spinal reflex is an unconscious response. The reaction is quick, so the body can avoid harm.
The same event can bring both kinds of response. A reflex may pull a hand away first, and a conscious decision may follow, such as choosing to treat the injury.
draft.remember: Conscious means aware and chosen. Unconscious happens before the brain is aware.

a.q: Which of these is an unconscious response?
opts: Pulling a hand back from a hot pan before feeling pain
Deciding to move a hand away from a warm pan
Choosing to put a hand under cold water after a burn
Stepping back from a pan after seeing steam rise
a.why: Pulling the hand back happens before the brain is aware of the heat, so it is unconscious. In the other options the person is aware of the stimulus and chooses to act, even if they act quickly.
a.clue: Which response happens before the person is aware of the stimulus?

b.q: Jai steps on a sharp shell on a beach in Torquay and his foot jerks up at once. Then he looks down and decides to hop to the sand. Which describes these two responses?
opts: The foot jerk is unconscious and the hop is conscious
The foot jerk is conscious and the hop is unconscious
Both are unconscious because both happened quickly
Both are conscious because both involved his foot
b.why: The foot jerk happened before Jai was aware of the shell, so it is unconscious. Choosing to hop involved awareness and a decision, so it is conscious. Speed alone does not make a response unconscious.
b.clue: Which response came before Jai was aware, and which came after he chose?

a.best: Pulling a hand back from a hot pan before feeling pain

b.best: The foot jerk is unconscious and the hop is conscious
